newsitem.title: CHINA: China tornado kills two children, nine missing.
newsitem.headline: China tornado kills two children, nine missing.

text.p: A tornado has struck China's southern province of Hainan, killing two children, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday. Nine people were missing.
The tornado hit Wuchang harbour, a major fishing port on the island, early on Tuesday, capsizing seven of the 60 vessels anchored in the harbour, Xinhua said.
Five people aboard the ships were seriously injured during the violent wind funnel's strike, which lasted six minutes.
More than 100 fishermen and officials rescued more than 70 people from the capsized ships, it said.
Tornadoes are rare in China. The last reported one struck the eastern province of Jiangsu in July 1996, killing 25 people.
